title: When the Cipher Falls Revisited
author: Ulyana Oyelaran
blurb: Casper Whitlock, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
